checklist_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for [tb-008, tb-009]: MUST evaluate polynomials on a coset that does not intersect the FFT evaluation domain?
checklist_items.property_text: coset_fft_field (SG-005) with shift_factor = PRIMITIVE_ROOT_OF_UNITY MUST evaluate polynomials on a coset that does not intersect the FFT evaluation domain. Specifically, for all x in the coset domain and all y in the FFT domain, x != y. This guarantees that division by the vanishing polynomial in recovery (SG-023) never encounters division by zero.
